participation.context: Accepted twelve, refused a coffer-count, and kept the chronicle off tomorrow's table.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named twelve shillings, shut the bag, and set no Rose figure beside it.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Counted twelve into his hand, and refused a rumour from the other house.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

relations.quote: Twelve shillings. The bag is shut.

story.body: You heard twelve shillings and had it said twice. You did not add it to a coffer, and you did not send it home. You let Heminges shut the bag. You left last Saturday unnamed, as it had been.

relations.quote: Twelve shillings. The bag is shut.

title: Took twelve shillings and heard the bag shut
